attestations.text: HUANG T'i-fang 黃體芳 (T. 漱蘭), Sept., 1832–1899, June-July, native of Jui-an, Chekiang, was one of the so-called "Four Admonishing Officials" (see under Chang P'ei-lun) at the close of the Ch'ing period.
黃體芳，字漱蘭，浙江瑞安人。

westernYears.note: Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.
Western year as printed; not a resolved Chinese civil year.

accounts.evidence: 黃體芳，字漱蘭，浙江瑞安人。同治二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。日探討掌故，慨然有經世志。累遷侍讀學士，頻上書言時政得失。晉、豫飢，請籌急賑，整吏治，清庶獄，稱旨。時議禁燒鍋裕民食，戶部覈駁，體芳謂燒鍋領帖，部獲歲銀三萬，因上董恂奸邪狀，坐鐫級。
